url.description: The url of the cookie, defaults to the orign of the current host

hostOnly.description: True if the cookie is a host-only cookie (i.e. a request's host must exactly match the domain of the cookie)

secure.description: True if the cookie is marked as Secure (i.e. its scope is limited to secure channels, typically HTTPS)

expiry.description:
When the cookie expires, specified in seconds since Unix Epoch.
Defaults to 20 years into the future if omitted.

(It works well in chrome but not in firefox)
